title: Ranked - Beta Season 2
headline: Ranked Beta Season 2 runs four months with a softer rank reset, a global redistribution of the ladder, and tighter rank-loss protection.
reset: Two-step adjustment: everyone's rank is first redistributed across the curve, then a soft reset of about -1 badge is applied on top.
The soft reset is significantly smaller than last season's; previous-season winrate shifts players an extra 1-2 subranks.
Redistribution accounts for the influx of new players, so some players will climb despite the reset.
Returning Ranked players skip calibration; anyone who sat out last season must calibrate.
Placement ceiling rises to Ascendant I, with up to Ascendant III for strong prior-season performance.

takeaways: Grinders gain: 350 points per game and a 1500 badge threshold make the climb faster, so volume matters more than a hot streak.
Phantom-plus players lose their safety net entirely, and everyone else has shields cut, so a bad run drops you faster than last season.
New-to-Ranked players should care about the hero unlock change: losses now count toward unlocking, so you reach a deep hero pool in fewer games.
Leaderboard chasers must keep playing: 50 matches in 30 days (15 per hero) is a rolling activity requirement, not a season total.
